answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity docks at the jetty, capped at three partners. Full standing needs twelve counterparties in ten epochs. A sybil farm is a nebula: hundreds of identities trading only among themselves. Inspectors map the graph like karst: inward loops mark hollow ground. Forging diversity costs 5 POA per deal, so 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 POA against a 30,000 pool. An honest agent pays once, keeping its full share.
